scope: Corollary 6.7 of the manuscript “Log abundance for compact Kähler spaces under logarithmic Iitaka subadditivity” (preprints/Log-abundance-for-compact-Kahler-spaces-under-logarithmic-Iitaka-subadditivity-October-6-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 46adc5be1070213b), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 124. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Y be a smooth compact Kähler manifold and E a holomorphic vector bundle of rank at least two. Write πE : PY (E) → Y and ζE = c1(OP(E)(1)). Suppose that a real class D on Y satisfies c1(H) ≤ kD whenever 0 ̸= H −→ E⊗k for a line bundle H and integer k ≥ 0. For a real class A on Y and a real number b ≥ 0, π∗ EA + bζE ≥ 0 =⇒ A + bD ≥ 0. (6.18)
